note: Every game branch of `FUN_1000_29c4` -- the `h` / `mh` beer routine, image `1000:29c4`..`1000:2c5e` -- classified against the port by Task 41. All 19 carried no `SEG:OFF` citation at the branch or its guard when Task 41 ran EXCEPT `1000:2a1d` and `1000:2a4c`, whose guards (`1000:2a18`, `1000:2a47`) the shipped `Game::beer` doc comment already names; those two are the `touched 2` in `docs/re/branches.md`'s per-entry row for this entry. The row set is therefore the whole branch population of the function, not the uncited subset -- `data/combat_uncited.json` is the shape, and the difference is deliberate: Task 42 has to cite 17 and must not re-cite the two, so both halves have to be present and derived. `tools/test_beer_arms.py` re-derives the population from `data/branches.json` and requires this file to cover it EXACTLY; no count here is hard-coded.

classes.implemented: `src/` evaluates this condition NOW. `src.module`, `src.function` and `src.expr` name the construct that does, and `src.recompute` is the command that finds it -- never a `src/` line number, which `docs/re/METHODOLOGY.md` forbids. `src.expr` is a paraphrase close enough to locate the construct and never a substitute for reading it. When two rows name the SAME construct -- the port evaluates one predicate where the original tests it more than once -- each carries a `src.discriminator`: the exact sub-expression of `expr` that row means. `tools/test_beer_arms.py`'s `test_no_two_rows_share_a_construct_without_saying_which_half_they_mean` requires it, so a row cannot silently borrow a sibling's construct while testing a different predicate.
classes.unimplemented: `src/` does not evaluate it. NO ROW USES THIS CLASS -- see `empty_classes_are_reported`.
classes.unreachable-in-port: the port deliberately diverges and `docs/re/gaps.md` records it. NO ROW USES THIS CLASS -- see `empty_classes_are_reported`.

empty_classes_are_reported: Two of the three classes are empty and that is stated rather than filled, because an escape-hatch class is how an inventory stops being falsifiable. The candidates were checked and rejected one by one. `1000:2a1d` (broken jaw) looked like `unreachable-in-port`: the port DOES evaluate the condition, so the class does not fit -- what diverges is the code AFTER the refusal prints, and that is recorded as a divergence in `divergences` and in `docs/re/gaps.md` instead of by mislabelling a branch. The six `h`/`mh` selections (`1000:2a74`, `2aaa`, `2afc`, `2b4a`, `2b93`, `2bba`) looked like `unimplemented` because one `single` boolean stands for six separate shortstring compares; `one_boolean_for_six_compares` is the flow argument that they are the same predicate, so they are `implemented`. Nothing in this routine is unported behaviour.

one_boolean_for_six_compares.claim: `Game::beer`'s single `single` boolean is faithful to the six later `call 0f78:0bd8` compares at `1000:2a6a`, `2aa0`, `2af2`, `2b40`, `2b89` (against `"h"`, CS 0x28c7) and `1000:2bb0` (against `"mh"`, CS 0x28c9).
established_from_flow: 1000:29fa and 1000:2a0c admit exactly two lines into the body; 1000:2a0e `jmp 0x2c58` returns for every other line, so on every path past 1000:2a11 the buffer holds `"h"` or `"mh"` and nothing else.

the buffer at [bp-0x100] is written only by the prologue's `1000:29e2 stosb` and `1000:29e6 rep movsb`, whose destination is ES:DI with ES set to SS at 1000:29d3/1000:29d5 -- and an aligned decode of all 298 instructions finds no other instruction in the routine whose destination is that buffer.
so each of the six compares re-evaluates a predicate that cannot have changed since 1000:29fa, and `single` == (`"h"`) is that predicate.

divergences.original: 1000:2a1d not taken -> 1000:2a1f prints CS 0x28cc (`^4Ты не можешь пить пиво из-за сломаной челюсти.`) and 1000:2a38 `jmp 0x2baa` enters the `mh` TAIL. For `mh` the tail then runs 1000:2bba..1000:2c53 with hp untouched, so 1000:2bc6 and 1000:2c0d both take, 1000:2c36 does not, and 1000:2c3d prints `^4Пива нету` (CS 0x2970) whenever 20ae:38c3 <= 0.
divergences.port: `Game::beer` prints the jaw refusal and `return`s, so `mh` + broken jaw + no beer writes one line where the original writes two.
divergences.reachable: yes -- 20ae:38b0 is set by combat at 1000:47ee / 1000:4820 and the beer counter is routinely 0; `mh` is accepted in combat through the second call site 1000:4b00.
